hypothesis: pooled domain-fixed-effect means and one shared rank-one energy-conserving conditional axis stabilize small-domain label-free transport
allowed_inputs: frozen feature caches, opaque source sidecars, renderer logs, and DINO checkpoint hash only

model.rank_transform: own-domain train empirical mid-CDF u; held uses frozen train ECDF
model.rank_quadratic: q0=6u^2-6u+1, positive-QR residualized against [1,z_centered], divided by positive infinity norm
model.pooled_mean: one OLS with domain intercept/raw-z slope blocks and one shared q column; every object weight is exactly one
model.shared_axis: H=sum q(rrT-C_domain)/sum q^2; G=sym(H@H); unique top eigenvector with largest-absolute-coordinate-positive sign
model.theta: sum(q*c)/sqrt(sum(q^2)*sum(c^2)); fail outside [-1,1] beyond numeric tolerance; never clamp
model.scales: domain energy intercepts with exp(theta*q) modulation and analytic normalizer conserving total block energy per row
model.transport: domain sorted opaque-ID shift-one train and balanced round-robin held; preserve recipient within-object offsets
model.mechanical_displacement: recipient final coordinate is appended bit-for-bit and never transported

crossfit.assignment: sort by sha256('splart-jsa-ect-fold-v1:'+domain+':'+opaque_object_id), balanced round-robin per domain
crossfit.preprocessing: each fold refits one joint-domain PCA16/mechanical standardization, both domain ECDF/q anchors, pooled mean/H/G/axis/theta, and domain energy intercepts on complement only
